test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an election there were only two candidates, Geeta and Shyama. Geeta received 15% of the total votes and Shyama received 8700 votes. 60% of the voters did not cast their vote to either of the two candidates. Find the total percentage of votes that Shyama received, assuming that all the votes cast were valid.
solution:
**Given:**

Geeta received 15% of the total votes.

Shyama received 8700 votes.

60% of the voters did not cast their vote to either of the two candidates.

All the votes cast were valid.

**Formula Used:**

Total votes = Votes received by Geeta + Votes received by Shyama + Votes not cast.

Percentage of votes received by Shyama = (Votes received by Shyama / Total votes) × 100.

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of votes be V .

Votes cast to Geeta = 15% of total votes = 0.15V

Votes not cast = 60% of total votes = 0.60V

Votes cast to Shyama = 8700.

From the formula:

Total votes = Votes received by Geeta + Votes received by Shyama + Votes not cast.

⇒ V = 0.15V + 8700 + 0.60V

⇒ V - 0.15V - 0.60V = 8700

⇒ 0.25V = 8700

⇒ V = 8700 / 0.25

⇒ V = 34800

Total votes = 34800.

Percentage of votes received by Shyama:

⇒ (Votes received by Shyama / Total votes) × 100

⇒ (8700 / 34800) × 100

⇒ 0.25 × 100

⇒ 25%

**Shyama received 25% of the total votes.**
